audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose treats Taliyah as a mobile champion who repositions with walls from level 1.
audit.why: Weaver's Wall is her ultimate (180/150/120s) and does not exist before level 6. Pre-6 she is a stationary poke mage whose only lockdown is Seismic Shove (14s at rank 1) knocking you into Unraveled Earth.
audit.corrected: Early difficulty reframed around the 1000-range Threaded Volley and the W-into-E stun; her mobility moved to the post-6 sections where it belongs.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3].side read 'Skill' while win[3] read 'Taliyah'; no spike text carries a cooldown number (packet flags zero sequencing cues).
audit.why: The level chart rendered two answers for Levels 4-5, and the advice gave the reader no clock to play against.
audit.corrected: Chart row aligned; Q (7s), W (14s) and R (180s) numbers written into the cooldown, trade and roam lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stun condition on Unraveled Earth was never stated.
audit.why: Unraveled Earth (E, 14s, 950) only stuns enemies who DASH through the mines or are KNOCKED through them. Anivia has no dash, so the mines alone can never stun her — Seismic Shove is the only delivery. Threaded Volley (7s at rank 1) is also stronger and slows when cast on her own Worked Ground.
audit.corrected: Advice now keys entirely off Seismic Shove's cooldown and off standing clear of Worked Ground.

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Crystallize has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Seismic Shove is 14s at rank 1 and it is the only way she stuns you: the Unraveled Earth mines need you knocked in. Step up while her W is down. - Threaded Volley is 7s and hits harder on Worked Ground — stay off her marked patches. - Crystallize is for when it all goes wrong.

edits.before: Taliyah wins by landing Seismic Shove, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Taliyah wins by shoving you into Unraveled Earth for the stun, then chipping the egg down from 1000 range.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Taliyah burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Threaten Q from 1075 while her Seismic Shove is down, land it, then E for double damage and walk — she has no dash to close after it.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Taliyah walks straight at you.
edits.after: Standing on her Worked Ground with no wall charged — the boulder hits harder there and the shove follows it in.

edits.before: If Taliyah gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Seismic Shove extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with R wave-clear and stay relevant through zone control.
edits.after: If Taliyah gets a kill, stop walking inside 900 units while Seismic Shove is up — that knock is the only thing that catches you. Two kills: farm with R from range and stay relevant through zone control.

edits.before: Carry by controlling space — storm and wall decide where fights happen, and your stun decides who dies first inside them.
edits.after: Carry by holding the chokes: her stun needs a knock-in, and storm plus wall leave her nowhere to shove you that helps her.

edits.before: The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Her stun needs Seismic Shove to knock you into the mines — while that 14s W is down, no minefield on the ground can hold you.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Taliyah burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Glacial Storm clears instantly, so her Worked Ground shove stops out-tempoing you and she cannot leave the wave to roam for free.

edits.before: Taliyah burns Seismic Shove on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: A whiffed Seismic Shove is 14 seconds in which she cannot stun anyone.

edits.before: Your wall is your Flash — a wasted Crystallize means the next gank kills the bird AND the egg.
edits.after: Threaded Volley is 7s at rank 1 and hits harder on her Worked Ground — never last-hit standing on it.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Taliyah walks straight at you.
edits.after: Weaver's Wall spans 2500 units at rank 1 — past river she can cut your retreat and arrive with her jungler on it.

edits.before: Taliyah's mobile poke and wall-repositioning let her outclass Anivia's static trading pattern before level 6.
edits.after: Taliyah's 1000-range Threaded Volley outpokes your static trading pattern, and it is back up every 7 seconds.

edits.before: Same story at level 4 — her mobility and poke threshold continue to outpace your trades.
edits.after: Level 3 completes Seismic Shove into Unraveled Earth — a stun combo you have no dash to leave.

edits.before: Taliyah's Q-W combo and wall-building mobility let her poke and reposition freely, punishing your slow-footed trades before level 6.
edits.after: Seismic Shove knocks you into Unraveled Earth for the stun, and Threaded Volley chips the egg down from 1000 range while you are held.

edits.before: Poke you down with Q-W combos while using her own walls to reposition freely
edits.after: Knock you into Unraveled Earth with Seismic Shove for a free stun combo

edits.before: Taliyah's mobility via Weaver's Wall and her Q-W poke combo let her control the trading pattern before you have any tools to answer, punishing your lack of escape. She'll look to poke you down and then roam using her wall-jumps to gank other lanes, so ward river proactively and play for CS rather than trades. Avoid extending past minions where her Q threatens double damage.
edits.after: Taliyah's 1000-range Threaded Volley and her Seismic Shove into Unraveled Earth stun let her control the trading pattern before you have any tools to answer. She has no wall to travel on until level 6, so pre-6 she simply poke-and-holds you off CS — ward river, play for farm, and step up only when her 14s W is spent. Never last-hit standing on Worked Ground she has already marked.

edits.before: Level 6 evens things out: Glacial Storm's area coverage forces her to respect your zone instead of freely weaving poke in and out, and your slow lets you punish her positioning mistakes. Use Storm to answer her roams by threatening the wave hard when she's gone, and look to catch her repositioning with Flash Frost. She still has strong jungle synergy through her ultimate, so track Weaver's Wall cooldown for potential ganks elsewhere.
edits.after: Level 6 evens things out: Glacial Storm's area coverage forces her to respect your zone instead of freely weaving poke in and out, and your slow lets you punish her positioning mistakes. Use Storm to answer her roams by threatening the wave hard when she's gone, and look to catch her repositioning with Flash Frost. Weaver's Wall is 180 seconds at rank 1 and spans 2500 units — the moment it is up, ping the sidelanes before she leaves.
